- [Analogies and blends - new category old ideas](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2006-01-01-analogies-new-category-old-ideas/index.md): The piece defines analogies as elaborated metaphors and outlines their cognitive, textual, and interactive functions.
- [Jak psát a nepsat česky](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-psat-a-nepsat-cesky/index.md): The review recommends a Czech writing guide that treats standard language as an evolving communicative system rather than a fixed set of prohibitions.
- [Jak společnosti kolabují](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-spolecnosti-kolabuji/index.md): The review explains Jared Diamond's argument that societies collapse through interactions among environmental pressures, cultural values, and collective decisions.
- [Mark Turner, Literární mysl: O původu jazyka a myšlení](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/mark-turner-literarni-mysl-o-puvodu-jazyka-a-mysleni/index.md): The review explains Mark Turner's claim that narrative and literary thought arise from the same conceptual integration processes as ordinary cognition.
- [Marx: Myslitel, jehož včera by se stále ještě mohlo stát naším zítra](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/marx-myslitel-jehoz-vcera-by-se-stale-jeste-mohlo-stat-nasim-zitra/index.md): The piece argues that Marx remains a major philosopher because his critique of capitalism, globalisation, and alienation still exposes contemporary social problems.
- [Nové myšlení o myšlení a o jazyce](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nove-mysleni-o-mysleni-a-o-jazyce/index.md): The piece argues that embodied cognitive linguistics explains language and thought better than formal models that treat the mind as a rule-processing computer.
- [O čápovi a lišce: Problémy kulturní a etnické integrace](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/o-capovi-a-lisce-problemy-kulturni-a-etnicke-integrace/index.md): The piece use the fable of the stork and the fox to frame problems of cultural and ethnic integration.
- [Pravdy, války a vtipy: Pohlednice z amerických politických debat](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/pravdy-valky-a-vtipy-pohlednice-z-americkych-politickych-debat/index.md): The feature explains American culture wars through their media institutions, polemical books, and Al Franken's liberal political satire.
- [Vyhánění z ráje](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/vyhaneni-z-raje/index.md): The essay argues that treating the Holocaust as irrational evil obscures how ordinary people and efficient institutions enabled cumulative radicalisation and mass murder.
- [Conceptualizing gender differences in behavior](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-29-conceptualizing-gender-differences-in-behavior/index.md): The post argues that reporting on gendered internet use assimilates evidence into conventional stereotypes while minimising findings that contradict them.
- [Towards a cognitive morphology of the folktale](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-29-towards-a-cognitive-morphology-of-the-folktale/index.md): The post proposes a cognitive revision of Propp's folktale morphology in which narrative elements pair form with meaning and combine through conceptual integration.
- [Complexities of representation of women in traditional narrative](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-25-complexities-of-representation-of-women-in-traditional-narrative/index.md): The post argues that traditional narratives combine contradictory images of women and that their social effects cannot be reduced to direct causation.
- [Creation of meaning and music analogies](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-25-creation-of-meaning-and-music-analogies/index.md): The post compares meaning-making to continuously adjusting a musical note in order to challenge static and minimal definitions of concepts.
- [New category: Feminism](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-25-new-category-feminism/index.md): The post defends feminism as the appropriate name for analysing women's position in society and cognition because the term preserves the movement's critical force.
- [Individuality and culturality of psychotherapeutic needs](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-20-individuality-and-culturality-of-psychotherapeutic-needs/index.md): The post argues that imposed psychological debriefing can obstruct culturally situated recovery and examines rebuilding as a metaphor for emotional life.
- [Parents' role in education - framing in practice](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-20-parents-role-in-education-framing-in-practice/index.md): The post identifies a radio debate about parental involvement as an example of competing and shifting cognitive models of education.
- [Determinism and evidentiary value of belief based on personal experience](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-19-determinism-and-evidentiary-value-of-belief-based-on-personal-experie/index.md): The post argues that personal experience can motivate both scientific and unscientific conclusions, so scientific authority requires more than an idealised method.
- [Expertise and suitability for policy responsibilities](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-19-expertise-and-suitability-for-policy-responsibilities/index.md): The post argues that expertise can narrow judgement, while public decision-making still depends on experts selected through political and group identities.
- [New home](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-18-new-home/index.md): The post announces that My Week in Thought has moved to the current site.
- [CADAAD - Conference on Discourse Analysis](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-15-cadaad-conference-on-discourse-analysis/index.md): The post announces the first CADAAD conference and its call for papers.
- [Consequences of video games - and the cognitive aspects of data interpretation](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-14-consequences-of-video-games-and-the-cognitive-aspects-of-data-interpr/index.md): The post argues that claims about video-game effects depend on narrative and cognitive schemas used to interpret evidence about large groups.
- [My Week In Thought and Hermeneutic Suspicion](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-14-my-week-in-thought-and-hermeneutic-suspicion/index.md): The post argues that myth-busting and scepticism are themselves narrative forms whose legitimacy must remain open to questioning.
- [There's no Wikipedia entry for 'moral responsibility' | The Register](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-12-theres-no-wikipedia-entry-for-moral-responsibility-the-register/index.md): The post defends Wikipedia as a broadly reliable and correctable reference source while arguing that all encyclopaedias require source criticism.
- [Perspective and data in historical analysis](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-11-perspective-and-data-in-historical-analysis/index.md): The post examines how the quantity and survival of evidence constrain historical interpretation without preventing extensive scholarship from fragmentary sources.
- [Online scholarship](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-10-online-scholarship/index.md): The post argues that rigorous narrative scholarship can appear online and address popular culture without institutional approval of the subject.
- [Complexities of women's rights](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-08-complexities-of-womens-rights/index.md): The post presents three conflicting conservative positions on increasing women's parliamentary representation as a persistent conceptual dilemma.
- [Conceptual integration and the creation of news](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-08-conceptual-integration-and-the-creation-of-news/index.md): The post explains how news formulas structure mental spaces that are blended with events to produce political reporting and argument.
- [Cultural images of the powerless](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-08-cultural-images-of-the-powerless/index.md): The post argues that powerful and subordinate cultures construct reciprocal stereotypes that combine resentment, admiration, condescension, and identification.
- [How we should judge torture - Los Angeles Times](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-08-how-we-should-judge-torture-los-angeles-times/index.md): The post argues that fictional narratives can normalise exceptional violence and that legal exceptions for torture would expand the circumstances treated as exceptional.
- [Reliability of common wisdom - models and power](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-08-reliability-of-common-wisdom-models-and-power/index.md): The post compares competing schemas for interpreting scientific consensus and dissent, using obesity and climate change as examples.
- [Salient cases and social causality](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-08-salient-cases-and-social-causality/index.md): The post compares aggregate and case-based models of media influence and shows how apparently incompatible causal accounts can be reconciled.
- [Navigating the 'human terrain' - Los Angeles Times](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-07-navigating-the-human-terrain-los-angeles-times/index.md): The post identifies the idea of human terrain as a conceptual blend connecting military targeting with cultural knowledge.
- [Universal preschool's and cause and effect in education](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-07-universal-preschools-and-cause-and-effect-in-education/index.md): The post examines how arguments for universal preschool combine economic returns, individual benefits, and social outcomes within one causal model.
- ['Gay weddings' become law in UK](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-05-gay-weddings-become-law-in-uk/index.md): The post argues that civil partnerships reveal the ritual basis of marriage and that changes in heterosexual marriage made same-sex marriage conceptually possible.
- [Anthropology.net | Beyond bones & stones](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-05-anthropologynet-beyond-bones-stones/index.md): The post recommends an online anthropology community as a model for a similar resource on metaphor and cognitive linguistics.
- [Kazakhstan and the principles of democracy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-05-kazakhstan-and-the-principles-of-democracy/index.md): The post argues that democratic laws and elections cannot substitute for institutions rooted in civil society.
- [Authors and texts](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-04-authors-and-texts/index.md): The post argues that an author's stated intention is only one perspective on a text and does not conclusively determine what the text means or does.
- [Common sense vs.hypocrisy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-04-common-sense-vshypocrisy/index.md): The post uses inconsistent attitudes to execution to argue that human reasoning relies on prototypes and weighted schemas rather than strict logical entailment.
- [Identity and modularity](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-04-identity-and-modularity/index.md): The post argues that locating a perceptual illusion in the brain does not establish that identity or higher cognition consists of independent modules.
- [Challenges facing feminism in post-communist Czech Republic](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-03-challenges-facing-feminism-in-post-communist-czech-republic/index.md): The post explains how communist legacies and post-communist hostility to feminism have limited recognition and enforcement of gender equality in the Czech Republic.
- [Digitizing literature and styles of reading](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-03-digitizing-literature-and-styles-of-reading/index.md): The post argues that digitised excerpts do not destroy literacy because readers use both fragmentary and immersive modes to understand texts.
- [Fiction as a resource for academic inquiry](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-03-fiction-as-a-resource-for-academic-inquiry/index.md): The post argues that fiction can supplement academic inquiry by presenting composite experiences and insights that analytic research may not capture.
- [A Man's Right to Choose - A Feminist Issue?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-02-a-mans-right-to-choose-a-feminist-issue/index.md): The post asks whether granting men greater reproductive and parental rights could weaken the gender symbolism that constrains women's choices.
- [Conceptual consequences](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-02-conceptual-consequences/index.md): The post uses attitudes to homosexuality to warn against assuming that one conceptual position deterministically produces another.
- [Culture wars and personal identity](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-02-culture-wars-and-personal-identity/index.md): The post argues that American culture-war participants experience opposing institutions as threats to the validity of their identities and conceptual frames.
- [Death penalty: Time to rethink? :: The Daily Herald, Provo Utah](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-02-death-penalty-time-to-rethink-the-daily-herald-provo-utah/index.md): The post separates symbolic judgements that a criminal deserves death from the irreversible and error-prone act of execution.
- [Why is the 'new' UK drive toward synthetic phonics ridiculous](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-12-01-why-is-the-new-uk-drive-toward-synthetic-phonics-ridiculous/index.md): The post argues that synthetic phonics cannot transform literacy or society because educational interventions operate within complex and recurring institutional patterns.
- [Some remarks on individualism and collectivism](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-30-bbc-thought-for-the-day-29-november-2005/index.md): The post contrasts individualist and collectivist accounts of sacrifice and argues that Western reporting interprets collective duty through individual motives.
- [Why school achievement isn't reaching the poor - The Boston Globe](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-30-why-school-achievement-isnt-reaching-the-poor-the-boston-globe/index.md): The post argues that isolated school successes do not provide a sufficient causal model for reforming a complex education system.
- [Labor's Lost Story](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-29-labors-lost-story/index.md): The post highlights how competing narratives about capitalism and labour shape arguments over job losses and social protection.
- [Terror's stealth weapon: women - Los Angeles Times](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-29-terrors-stealth-weapon-women-los-angeles-times/index.md): The post argues that women's participation in terrorism can be absorbed into existing gender hierarchies rather than weakening them.
- [Managing social processes vs. managing the context of social processes](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-28-managing-social-processes-vs-managing-the-context-of-social-processes/index.md): The post argues that complex social systems are more amenable to changes in their conditions than to direct control, while still requiring regulation of harmful outcomes.
- [Real literacy?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-28-real-literacy/index.md): The post rejects a single model of real literacy and argues that concerns about digital snippets must account for varied reading and information practices.
- [Speed of technological progress and social effects](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-28-speed-of-technological-progress-and-social-effects/index.md): The post argues that rapid increases in computing power do not predict social change because technical capabilities interact unevenly with cognitive and social constraints.
- [There's no 'good' divorce - The Boston Globe](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-28-theres-no-good-divorce-the-boston-globe/index.md): The post challenges research that treats all effects of divorce as damage and argues that children normally develop multiple identities across contexts.
- [Models in professional knowledge](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-27-models-in-professional-knowledge/index.md): The post asks how professionals construct and reconcile conflicting models derived from aggregate evidence and salient individual cases.
- [Discrepancies in Testing](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-26-discrepancies-in-testing/index.md): The post argues that discrepancies between state and federal tests expose the limited relationship between test performance and broader knowledge or ability.
- [Intellectual defense of xenophobia](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-26-intellectual-defense-of-xenophobia/index.md): The post argues that xenophobic accounts may describe intercultural conflict more accurately than naive multiculturalism while failing because they treat cultures as static.
- [The American Dream and varieties of national self-esteem](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-25-the-american-dream-and-varieties-of-national-self-esteem/index.md): The post argues that admiration and resentment of the United States coexist in foreign perceptions of the American dream.
- [They Held Their Noses, and Ate - New York Times](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-24-they-held-their-noses-and-ate-new-york-times/index.md): The post argues that English colonists judged Indigenous food practices through cultural assumptions about proper cultivation and asks how such judgements shaped settlement.
- [On some mental representations of personal identity](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-23-some-mental-representations-of-personal-identity/index.md): The post uses a misspelled name to examine how names and other social markers contribute to mental representations of personal identity.
- [Turning academia into a cafeteria - Los Angeles Times](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-23-turning-academia-into-a-cafeteria-los-angeles-times/index.md): The post examines how market language about choice enters academic discourse while questioning broad claims about the damage caused by such language.
- [Values, rules, patterns and theories of social causation](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-23-bbc-news-politics-a-third-of-pubs-to-open-longer/index.md): The post compares competing causal models of extended pub hours and argues that rule changes may create conditions for cultural values to change.
- [Ad-hoc metaphors as cohesive devices](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-22-ad-hoc-metaphors/index.md): The post identifies an extended political analogy as a cohesive frame that holds an argument together.
- [Laws of social and natural sciences](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-22-laws-of-social-and-natural-sciences/index.md): The post argues that social regularities can be treated like natural laws whose effects may be mitigated even when their exact outcomes cannot be predicted.
- [Marx's and Darwin's accomplishments: Finding the mechanism of evolution and social change?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-22-marxs-and-darwins-accomplishments-finding-the-mechanism-of-evolution-/index.md): The post considers a cautious analogy between Darwin's mechanism of natural selection and Marx's account of historical development.
- [Possible cognitive and affective implications of the new media paradigm shift](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-22-possible-cognitive-and-affective-implications-of-the-new-media-paradi/index.md): The post weighs the access and flexibility provided by digital media against losses in accidental discovery and exposure to varied content.
- [Socio-economic trends in interaction](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-22-socio-economic-trends-in-interaction/index.md): The post uses an interactive comparison of Thatcher-era trends to question claims that prosperity reliably trickles down.
- [Thatcher's role for women and the influence of women in politics on women's rights](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-22-thatchers-role-for-women-and-the-influence-of-women-in-politics-on-wo/index.md): The post argues that women reaching high political office does not by itself advance women's rights and compares the symbolic roles of several women leaders.
- [Access vs. close-reading journalism as a metaphor for educational standards](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-21-access-vs-close-reading-journalism-as-a-metaphor-for-educational-stan/index.md): The post uses the contrast between access journalism and close reading to argue that guided analysis can matter more than expert transmission in education.
- [More on theory and fact (medicine and ritual)](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-21-more-on-theory-and-fact/index.md): The post uses conflicting claims about homeopathy to examine how facts are reconciled with scientific and symbolic theories of causation.
- [Oral vs. written tradition and new technologies](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-21-oral-vs-written-tradition-and-new-technologies/index.md): The post argues that new media alter the relative dominance and delivery of oral and written storytelling without simply replacing older forms.
- [The Bosnian Example for Iraq](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-21-the-bosnian-example-for-iraq/index.md): The post examines Bosnia as an analogy for Iraq and asks how private analogies become established structures for public reasoning.
- [The rituals and mythic nature of democracy and the press](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-21-the-rituals-and-mythic-nature-of-democracy/index.md): The post highlights an account of the press as a communal ritual that sustains democratic identity.
- [Some misconceptions by the defenders of the Theory of Evolution](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-18-reason-fact-and-fiction-on-evolution-intelligent-designs-five-favorit/index.md): The post distinguishes evolutionary facts from theories of evolutionary mechanisms and proposes a way to discuss intelligent design in science education.
- [Welcome to Dominik's Week in Thought](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/2005-11-17-welcome-to-dominiks-week-in-thought/index.md): The post introduces a blog intended to track thoughts arising from the author's online life.
- [Harry Potter a Mýtus věčného návratu](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/harry-potter-a-mytus-vecneho-navratu/index.md): The piece interprets the Harry Potter stories through recurring mythic structures while explaining their appeal to child and adult readers.
- [Nerušme komunisty: Aneb polemický deník angažovaného emigranta o utopické demokracii](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nerusme-komunisty-aneb-polemicky-denik-angazovaneho-emigranta-o-utopicke-demokra/index.md): The piece argues that banning communist expression weakens democratic principles and confuses political opposition with criminal prohibition.
- [Kauzy a příčiny: metafory politického chápání](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/kauzy-a-priciny-metafory-politickeho-chapani/index.md): The piece argues that political scandals become intelligible through competing metaphors that select different causes and responsibilities.
- [Purizmus, předsudky a pitominy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/purizmus-predsudky-a-pitominy/index.md): The piece rejects linguistic purism as a collection of social prejudices that mistakes ordinary language change for decline.
- [Argumenty pro a proti valce](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/argumenty-pro-a-proti-valce/index.md): The piece argues that the principal justifications offered for invading Iraq do not establish a sufficient case for war.
- [Jak lékaři přicházejí na svět: Problémové učení medicíny na University of Glasgow](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-lekari-prichazeji-na-svet-problemove-uceni-mediciny-na-university-of-glasgow/index.md): The piece reports how Glasgow Medical School uses problem-based learning and argues that the approach develops more adaptable and independent doctors.
- [Kam se poděla válka?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/kam-se-podela-valka/index.md): The column shows how George W. Bush and Saddam Hussein used metaphor to frame the Iraq War while avoiding or redirecting the word war itself.
- [Monty Python a případ mrtvého papouška](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/monty-python-a-pripad-mrtveho-papouska/index.md): The piece traces Monty Python's television, film, and individual careers and explains the group's lasting influence on international comedy.
- [Naživo](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nazivo/index.md): The piece criticises live television coverage that presents the Iraq war as spectacle while concealing the people killed by the weapons it shows.
- [Válka v tropech](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/valka-v-tropech/index.md): The essay explains how metaphors such as war on terror and Saddam as Hitler frame political reasoning and make military action appear necessary.
- [Xenofob na hrad opravy pro LN](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/xenofob-na-hrad-opravy-pro-ln/index.md): The piece argues that Václav Klaus mistakes assimilation for integration and that multiculturalism must confront rather than deny fear of difference.
- [Úžasný Mauric a jeho vzdělaní hlodvaci](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/uzasny-mauric-a-jeho-vzdelani-hlodvaci/index.md): The review praises Terry Pratchett's comic reworking of the Pied Piper story while criticising errors and awkward choices in the Czech translation.
- [Čas možná už nadchází](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/cas-mozna-uz-nadchazi/index.md): The essay argues that Czech democracy must confront the Communist Party's continuity with the former regime as directly as West Germany confronted its Nazi past.
- [Milujte se a nemnožte se](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/milujte-se-a-nemnozte-se/index.md): The piece argues that anxieties about ageing populations and migration depend on political choices about family, labour, and social provision.
- [Americký prezident, císař světa](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/americky-prezident-cisar-sveta/index.md): The piece uses a Washington Post quotation to argue that even liberal American commentary treats the world as a domain of United States responsibility and control.
- [Czech Hiccup by Hiccup: The Casual Visitor's Primer](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/czech-hiccup-by-hiccup-the-casual-visitors-primer/index.md): The piece teaches visitors a compact set of Czech words and phrases for everyday travel situations.
- [Hledání smyslu lidské existence](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/hledani-smyslu-lidske-existence/index.md): The review finds Milan Machovec's Smysl lidské existence compelling in its humanism but weakened by elitism and selective use of evidence.
- [Hledání univerzálního porozumění](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/hledani-univerzalniho-porozumeni/index.md): The piece argues that universal values do not guarantee mutual understanding because cultures implement shared concepts through different communicative practices.
- [It's a challenge!](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/its-a-challenge/index.md): The piece explains why the English word challenge lacks a single reliable Czech equivalent and advises speakers to state the intended meaning.
- [Jak neměřit člověka](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-nemerit-cloveka/index.md): The review recommends Stephen Jay Gould's critique of scientific racism and the misuse of intelligence testing as a warning against treating science as culturally neutral.
- [Joe Haldeman: Věčná svoboda, Polaris 2001, 231 stran](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/joe-haldeman-vecna-svoboda-polaris-2001-231-stran/index.md): The review finds Věčná svoboda an unconventional and thought-provoking conclusion to Joe Haldeman's trilogy despite a familiar resolution and translation errors.
- [Mrtví jako my](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/mrtvi-jako-my/index.md): The piece argues that Afghan and Palestinian deaths deserve the same moral weight and individual attention as American and Israeli deaths.
- [Příklady politické korektnosti](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/priklady-politicke-korektnosti/index.md): The explainer surveys English terms associated with political correctness and distinguishes inclusive changes from mistaken or discriminatory applications.
- [Terry Pratchett: Zloděj času](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/terry-pratchett-zlodej-casu/index.md): The review recommends Thief of Time as a philosophically engaged Discworld novel even though it is not among Terry Pratchett's best.
- [V-Day -- Den-V Valentýn, Vagína, Vítězství na násilím](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/v-day-den-v-valentyn-vagina-vitezstvi-na-nasilim/index.md): The feature describes the global V-Day movement's use of performances and campaigns to confront sexual violence against women.
- [Války o Darwina: aneb o potyčkách na okrajích vědy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/valky-o-darwina-aneb-o-potyckach-na-okrajich-vedy/index.md): The review uses Andrew Brown's account of disputes over evolutionary theory to examine how scientific arguments reflect personal, institutional, and moral commitments.
- [Výchova k multikulturalismu](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/vychova-k-multikulturalismu/index.md): The review values Jan Průcha's evidence on multicultural education but criticises his positivism and limited attention to classroom practice and adult learning.
- [Zemanova selhání](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/zemanova-selhani/index.md): The piece argues that Miloš Zeman's disputed interview revealed a failure of diplomatic communication rather than insufficient English.
- [Češi pod vodou](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/cesi-pod-vodou/index.md): The essay argues that interpreting misconduct during floods as uniquely Czech makes universal human behaviour feel manageable but can dehumanise people outside the national group.
- [Pravé lži](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/prave-lzi/index.md): The piece argues that broadcasting True Lies without critical context reinforces dehumanising representations of Palestinians and Arabs.
- [0004:6000](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/0004-6000/index.md): The piece argues that treating wartime deaths as a score turns vengeance into a contest and obscures its human cost.
- [37 000 pochybností](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/37-000-pochybnosti/index.md): The piece argues that intellectual doubt is necessary during war while Afghans need material aid rather than symbolic humanitarian gestures.
- [4 předsudky o vzdělávání dospělých, jak je známe z filmu Marečku, podejte mi pero](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/4-predsudky-o-vzdelavani-dospelych-jak-je-zname-z-filmu-marecku-podejte-mi-pero/index.md): The piece uses four scenes from Marečku, podejte mi pero to correct common misconceptions about adult education.
- [Ach jo: aneb o EU, kde zítra už znamená pozdě](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/ach-jo-aneb-o-eu-kde-zitra-uz-znamena-pozde/index.md): The piece rejects nationalist objections to Czech membership of the European Union and argues that integration is politically necessary.
- [Civilizace a civilizovanost tady a dnes](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/civilizace-a-civilizovanost-tady-a-dnes/index.md): The piece argues that answering terrorism through unilateral military revenge contradicts the legal and moral values invoked in defence of civilisation.
- [Co se v stáří naučíš...](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/co-se-v-stari-naucis/index.md): The piece explains how adults learn, challenges age-based misconceptions, and argues for specialised preparation for adult educators.
- [David a Leigh Eddings](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/david-a-leigh-eddings/index.md): The review presents the second Althalus volume as an accessible continuation of David and Leigh Eddings's popular humorous fantasy world.
- [Do zbraně](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/do-zbrane/index.md): The piece argues that Czech military reform should include women through equal obligations, active recruitment, and temporary positive discrimination.
- [Filozofická hagiografie](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/filozoficka-hagiografie/index.md): The piece analyses Tomáš Halík's portrait of Jan Patočka as a hagiographic narrative that constructs a philosophical saint.
- [Gramatika není gramotnost](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/gramatika-neni-gramotnost/index.md): The piece argues that Czech schools should teach functional literacy and work with texts instead of prioritising grammatical terminology.
- [Harry Potter a ohnivý pohár](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/harry-potter-a-ohnivy-pohar/index.md): The review introduces the fourth Harry Potter novel as a longer and more mature continuation that retains the series' familiar magical world.
- [Internet a vzdělávání: Více než možnost](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/internet-a-vzdelavani-vice-nez-moznost/index.md): The piece shows schools how to use the internet as an information source, a meeting place, and a medium for teaching rather than as a symbolic acquisition.
- [Jak se dělá argument aneb polemický snář](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-se-dela-argument-aneb-polemicky-snar/index.md): The column apologises for insulting Ludvík Vaculík while defending vigorous public argument and criticism of reputational authority.
- [Jak se učíme: Úvod](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-se-ucime-uvod/index.md): The piece introduces learning styles as a way to examine individual differences while warning that educational theories simplify complex practice.
- [Když posadíte sedmiletého člověka do třídy na čtyři hodiny týdně, naučí se toho za rok méně než motivovaný dospělý za měsíc. Jediné, v čem děti často excelují, je výslovnost.](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/kdyz-posadite-sedmileteho-cloveka-do-tridy-na-ctyri-hodiny-tydne-nauci-se-toho-z/index.md): The piece corrects six common myths about foreign-language learning and gives practical advice on age, immersion, teachers, grammar, and methods.
- [Kognitivní styly - 4MAT](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/kognitivni-styly-4mat/index.md): The piece explains the 4MAT model of four learning preferences and shows how teachers can design lessons that address each one.
- [Kolik jazyků znáš...?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/kolik-jazyku-znas/index.md): The piece explains how children manage multiple languages and advises parents on context, literacy, identity, emotion, and code-switching.
- [Levá a pravá hemisféra](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/leva-a-prava-hemisfera/index.md): The piece treats left-brain and right-brain preferences as a teaching metaphor and argues that lessons should support both analytical and intuitive learners.
- [Lidové Noviny, česká média a potlačování názorů](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/lidove-noviny-ceska-media-a-potlacovani-nazoru/index.md): The piece argues that Czech media narrowed legitimate debate about war by excluding or discrediting dissenting views.
- [Marečku podejte mi pero:](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/marecku-podejte-mi-pero/index.md): The piece explains why adult education matters, how adults learn, and why organisations need instructors trained specifically to teach them.
- [Maturity za kanálem](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/maturity-za-kanalem/index.md): The piece explains British GCSE and A-level examinations as a system balancing student choice with national standards while retaining significant weaknesses.
- [Miroslav Zamboch](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/miroslav-zamboch/index.md): The review recommends Miroslav Žamboch's Na ostřích čepelí as a strong Czech fantasy adventure despite its need for closer editing.
- [Mým novinám](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/mym-novinam/index.md): The open letter asks Lidové noviny to publish dissenting views on the bombing of Afghanistan and to represent Afghan civilian victims as individual human beings.
- [Mýty a pověry o učení se cizím jazykům](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/myty-a-povery-o-uceni-se-cizim-jazykum/index.md): The piece corrects common myths about foreign-language learning and gives practical advice on age, immersion, teachers, grammar, and teaching methods.
- [Negramotnost? V Evropě?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/negramotnost-v-evrope/index.md): The piece explains the scale of adult functional illiteracy in Europe and argues that effective provision must address teaching quality, social position, and learners' sense of agency.
- [O drobné občanské nesvobodě](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/o-drobne-obcanske-nesvobode/index.md): The piece argues that routine demands for identification normalise avoidable restrictions on privacy and civic freedom.
- [O pocitu bezmoci](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/o-pocitu-bezmoci/index.md): The essay finds a shared sense of political powerlessness beneath opposing attitudes towards protest and police violence.
- [Omítková výuka](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/omitkova-vyuka/index.md): The essay argues that schools must teach reading comprehension and critical thinking directly instead of treating grammar instruction as a substitute.
- [Pedagogika utlacovanych](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/pedagogika-utlacovanych/index.md): The essay applies Paulo Freire's pedagogy to adult education and the political exclusion of disadvantaged groups in Britain.
- [Penis Ludvíka Vaculíka](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/penis-ludvika-vaculika/index.md): The essay criticises Ludvík Vaculík's treatment of women as sexual objects and argues that gender equality requires sustained self-examination.
- [Plebejství BBC nebo kazatelství BL?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/plebejstvi-bbc-nebo-kazatelstvi-bl/index.md): The essay disputes Jan Čulík's condemnation of Czech BBC broadcasting by comparing its practices with BBC Radio 4.
- [Poslední poslední slovo Ludvíka Vaculíka ukázalo nejen, že on sám nikdy nepřestal být stalinistou,...](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/posledni-posledni-slovo-ludvika-vaculika-ukazalo-nejen-ze-on-sam-nikdy-neprestal/index.md): The essay rejects Ludvík Vaculík's call for violent suppression of protesters and defends public protest as a necessary democratic right.
- [Proč, jak a kdy vzdělávat učitele jazyků](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/proc-jak-a-kdy-vzdelavat-ucitele-jazyku/index.md): The explainer argues that language teachers need adaptable initial preparation followed by practice and continuing professional education.
- [Příprava učitelů cizích jazyků v České republice](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/priprava-ucitelu-cizich-jazyku-v-ceske-republice/index.md): The feature compares Czech university preparation for language teachers with short practical TEFL qualifications and argues for stronger links between theory and classroom practice.
- [Příručka pochybujícího liberála](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/prirucka-pochybujiciho-liberala/index.md): The essay presents nineteen reasons to question the legal, moral, and strategic case for the war in Afghanistan.
- [Setkání s češtinou](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/setkani-s-cestinou/index.md): The feature reports how an international conference brought comparative and practical perspectives on Czech language research to Czech scholars.
- [Smrt Amazonky](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/smrt-amazonky/index.md): The feature marks Taqui Altounyan's death by recounting her role as a model for Arthur Ransome's characters and her independent writing life.
- [Solomon Kane](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/solomon-kane/index.md): The review recommends Robert E. Howard's Solomon Kane stories for their dark atmosphere, clean narration, and place in fantasy history.
- [Tak už dost](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/tak-uz-dost/index.md): The piece condemns calls for indiscriminate retaliation after 11 September and argues that killing Afghan civilians would destroy the United States' moral claim.
- [Terry Pratchett: Kobercové](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/terry-pratchett-kobercove/index.md): The review praises Terry Pratchett's revised early novel The Carpet People and his Discworld novel The Truth for combining humour, imagination, and humane satire.
- [Titulek](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/titulek/index.md): The column satirises alarmist and dull newspaper headlines while criticising editors who replace authors' titles without useful self-scrutiny.
- [Tom Holt: Čekal jsem někoho delšího](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/tom-holt-cekal-jsem-nekoho-delsiho/index.md): The review recommends Tom Holt's comic fantasy for applying precise English humour and absurdity to Germanic legends.
- [Ukončete výstup a nástup, brány vzdělávání se zavírají](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/ukoncete-vystup-a-nastup-brany-vzdelavani-se-zaviraji/index.md): The essay argues that final examinations reward short-term recall and should give way to broader assessment of skills and work produced throughout study.
- [Vizuální, audiální, motorický -- jak vnímáme](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/vizualni-audialni-motoricky-jak-vnimame/index.md): The explainer distinguishes visual, auditory, and motor learning preferences while warning against treating any one style as superior.
- [Zpráva o cestě do fantazie a zase zpátky](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/zprava-o-ceste-do-fantazie-a-zase-zpatky/index.md): The explainer describes fantasy through its journeys, invented worlds, moral structures, literary antecedents, and Czech publishing landscape.
- [Člověk žena: Kde jsou Vaginální monology?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/clovek-zena-kde-jsou-vaginalni-monology/index.md): The feature uses a London performance of The Vagina Monologues to trace feminist change and argue that Czech public debate has denied women's equality the cultural reckoning experienced elsewhere.
- [Brezinovy hyeny](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/brezinovy-hyeny/index.md): The piece criticises post-September 11 rhetoric that treats dissenting commentary as moral complicity with terrorism.
- [A Piece of *Koláč*](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/a-piece-of-kolac/index.md): The piece explains Czech pastries and the vocabulary, customs, and sayings associated with them.
- [Ajajaj — Statistika, testy a rasové nerovnosti](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/ajajaj-statistika-testy-a-rasove-nerovnosti/index.md): The piece argues that racial disparities in test results cannot be interpreted responsibly without examining sampling, social conditions, and the limits of statistical inference.
- [Dva jazyky jedna hlava: Dětství, jinošství a tak dále](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/dva-jazyky-jedna-hlava-detstvi-jinosstvi-a-tak-dale/index.md): The piece explains childhood bilingualism and gives parents practical guidance on language separation, literacy, identity, and motivation.
- [How do you think you're going?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/how-do-you-think-youre-going/index.md): The piece explains how Czech verbs of motion distinguish walking, travelling by vehicle, flying, and other kinds of movement.
- [It is necessary!](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/it-is-necessary/index.md): The piece introduces a column about words and constructions that resist direct translation between English and Czech.
- [Nebojte se dvojjazyčné výchovy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nebojte-se-dvojjazycne-vychovy/index.md): The piece explains how children acquire multiple languages and gives parents practical guidance on contexts, literacy, motivation, and cultural identity.
- [Nobody's perfect](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nobodys-perfect/index.md): The piece contrasts the Czech and English tense systems and explains why English perfect tenses lack direct Czech equivalents.
- [The daily *chleba* and *rohlík*](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/the-daily-chleba-and-rohlik/index.md): The piece explains Czech categories of bread and rolls together with the customs and sayings attached to them.
- [The Road to Czech Paradise](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/the-road-to-czech-paradise/index.md): The piece recommends routes, towns, castles, and outdoor destinations for travelling beyond Prague in the Czech Republic.
- [The Story of Czech](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/the-story-of-czech/index.md): The piece introduces the history and structure of Czech while advising learners how to approach the language.
- [A Brief But Uplifting Introduction to Learning the Czech Language for the Faint of Heart (A Twelve-Step Program)](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/a-brief-but-uplifting-introduction-to-learning-the-czech-language-for-the-faint-/index.md): The piece presents a twelve-step programme for overcoming common obstacles to learning Czech.
- [Czech and the Computer](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/czech-and-the-computer/index.md): The piece explains how to configure older computers for Czech fonts, keyboard input, spelling tools, and web pages.
- [Czech Language Inside Out](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/czech-language-inside-out/index.md): The piece gives newcomers a practical orientation to Czech pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary, and language-learning resources.
- [Czech: Frequently Asked Questions](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/czech-frequently-asked-questions/index.md): The piece answers common questions about the history, grammar, dialects, and perceived difficulty of Czech.
- [Overview of Czech Textbooks](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/overview-of-czech-textbooks/index.md): The piece compares Czech coursebooks, recordings, and dictionaries for learners at different levels.
- [Top 5 Frustrations with Learning Czech](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/top-5-frustrations-with-learning-czech/index.md): The piece addresses five common frustrations that discourage learners of Czech and suggests practical responses.
- [Jak na dovolenou bez cestovní kanceláře (ale s Internetem)](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-na-dovolenou-bez-cestovni-kancelare-ale-s-internetem/index.md): The piece explains how to research, arrange, and pay for an independent holiday using internet services.
- [V moci jazyka: Nad knihou ‘Řeč komunistické moci’](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/v-moci-jazyka-nad-knihou-rec-komunisticke-moci/index.md): The review praises Petr Fidelius's analysis of communist language while questioning whether some identified mechanisms are specific to communism or general properties of language.
- [Ve stopách Klubu lysek](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/ve-stopach-klubu-lysek/index.md): The feature recounts a four-day sailing journey through the Norfolk Broads in the locations of Arthur Ransome's Coot Club.
- [Detektivky už dnes netáhnou](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/detektivky-uz-dnes-netahnou/index.md): Zdeněk Volný discusses writing Dívka z přehrady with Jan Cimický, Czech crime fiction, and changing reader demand.
- [About Schemas and Propositions](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/about-schemas-and-propositions-substack/index.md): The essay introduces a publication about how tacit schemas enable humans and language models to construct and understand propositions.
- [Američtí radikálové: 125 let Noama Chomského a Michaela Moorea](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/americti-radikalove-125-let-noama-chomskeho-a-michaela-moorea/index.md): The piece compares Noam Chomsky and Michael Moore as influential but contested American political activists with different intellectual and artistic careers.
- [Arthur Ransome](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/arthur-ransome/index.md): The review recommends Arthur Ransome's unfinished Lysky na severu chiefly to existing admirers while criticising the Czech edition's cover.
- [Barack Obama: The Audacity of Hope: Thoughts on Reclaiming the American Dream](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/barack-obama-the-audacity-of-hope-thoughts-on-reclaiming-the-american-dream/index.md): The review presents The Audacity of Hope as evidence that Barack Obama's rhetoric rests on pragmatic political judgement rather than empty optimism.
- [Britský sen aneb, to by se v Anglii stát nemohlo](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/britsky-sen-aneb-to-by-se-v-anglii-stat-nemohlo/index.md): The piece challenges Czech idealisations of Britain by examining scandals and institutional failures within British democracy.
- [Brána jazyků stále ještě uzavřená: Nad knihou Didaktika cizích jazyků na přelomu staletí](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/brana-jazyku-stale-jeste-uzavrena-nad-knihou-didaktika-cizich-jazyku-na-prelomu-/index.md): The review argues that Didaktika cizích jazyků na přelomu staletí substitutes academic classification for practical guidance to language teachers.
- [Chvála politické korektnosti](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/chvala-politicke-korektnosti/index.md): The piece defends political correctness as a natural form of language change that challenges entrenched discrimination without by itself securing equality.
- [Chvála pozitivní diskriminace: Od segregace k integraci v USA](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/chvala-pozitivni-diskriminace-od-segregace-k-integraci-v-usa/index.md): The piece argues that affirmative action can counter durable inequalities created by segregation even when formal discrimination has ended.
- [Co je to civilizace](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/co-je-to-civilizace/index.md): The piece distinguishes three meanings of civilisation and explains how conflating them can legitimise dehumanising responses to terrorism.
- [Co nás zajímá](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/co-nas-zajima/index.md): The piece argues that citizens and newspapers must attend to distant conflicts because local moral responsibility depends on understanding global history and present suffering.
- [Daniel Handler, alias Lemmony Snicket](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/daniel-handler-alias-lemmony-snicket/index.md): Daniel Handler discusses the international reception, literary influences, educational elements, and authorial persona behind his Lemony Snicket books.
- [Demokracie a demokratismus](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/demokracie-a-demokratismus/index.md): The piece distinguishes democratic practice from democratism, an ideology that treats one political model as universally sufficient.
- [Digitální iluze redux: Iluze pokroku](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/digitalni-iluze-redux-iluze-pokroku/index.md): The column argues that the internet changes specific practices without removing the social institutions, trust, and human limits that shape communication.
- [Digitální iluze: Přelud rychlosti](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/digitalni-iluze-prelud-rychlosti/index.md): The column argues that faster computers do not automatically solve hard cognitive problems or transform society as technological forecasts claim.
- [Dva autoři a jedna detektivka](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/dva-autori-a-jedna-detektivka/index.md): The review recommends Dívka z přehrady as a coherent Czech crime novel while criticising its psychological label and poor physical presentation.
- [Evidence-based Education Policy: What Evidence? What Basis? Whose Policy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/evidence-based-education-policy-what-evidence-what-basis-whose-policy/index.md): The piece reviews three books to show why expertise combines practical competence, social recognition, and contested judgements about evidence.
- [Feminismus na konci vaginálního temna](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/feminismus-na-konci-vaginalniho-temna/index.md): The piece uses The Vagina Monologues to argue that Czech public debate missed the feminist reckoning needed to discuss women's sexuality and equality openly.
- [Gangsta teachers need 'spect: Discursive positioning of a pedagogic power play](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/gangsta-teachers-need-spect-discursive-positioning-of-a-pedagogic-power-play/index.md): This essay argues that moralising about accidental phone interruptions reinforces unequal power between lecturers and their audiences.
- [Hackeři života](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/hackeri-zivota/index.md): The piece presents hacking as a collaborative ethic of technical curiosity, freedom, and creative problem-solving rather than an inherently criminal activity.
- [Jak USB klíčenky mohou zachránit svět](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-usb-klicenky-mohou-zachranit-svet/index.md): The piece uses the replacement of floppy disks by USB drives to argue that durable solutions can change an entire system rather than improve its existing components.
- [Jak vypadá vítězství terorismu?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/jak-vypada-vitezstvi-terorismu/index.md): The piece argues that the metaphor of war on terrorism obscures political causes and allows fear to redefine democratic priorities.
- [Kam se poděla literatura?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/kam-se-podela-literatura/index.md): The piece argues that television series now perform many cultural functions once monopolised by novels and presents Buffy the Vampire Slayer as a canonical narrative work.
- [Konečně školné: jenže k čemu je dobré?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/konecne-skolne-jenze-k-cemu-je-dobre/index.md): The piece supports tuition fees as a limited way to balance private and public benefits while rejecting claims that fees alone will fund, improve, or diversify universities.
- [Krok stranou](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/krok-stranou/index.md): The review presents Katharyn Rosser's The Sidestep Chronicle as an accomplished online fan-fiction novel that exceeds the conventions of its genre.
- [Lesk a bída online davů: Od Twitteru po Creative Commons](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/lesk-a-bida-online-davu-od-twitteru-po-creative-commons/index.md): The piece reviews accounts of online crowds to examine how digital communities organise, create shared value, require governance, and support new economic models.
- [Literatura jako forma vyprávění: *Fanfiction* a narativní komunity](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/literatura-jako-forma-vypraveni-fanfiction-a-narativni-komunity/index.md): The piece explains fanfiction as a form of participatory storytelling sustained by online narrative communities.
- [Magie - sestra vzdělávání](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/magie-sestra-vzdelavani/index.md): The piece argues that education policy often mistakes suggestive similarities and metaphors for causal evidence about prosperity, democracy, employment, and literacy.
- [Manifest levicového intelektuála](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/manifest-levicoveho-intelektuala/index.md): The satirical piece rejects caricatures of left-wing intellectuals and questions claims that Western power consistently embodies absolute moral values.
- [Maso, ženy a svoboda duše](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/maso-zeny-a-svoboda-duse/index.md): The piece argues that education should confront the unequal representation of women while preserving open discussion rather than imposing approved readings.
- [Metafora trhu ve vzdělávání aneb konec bohemistiky za kanálem?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/metafora-trhu-ve-vzdelavani-aneb-konec-bohemistiky-za-kanalem/index.md): The piece argues that British Czech studies cannot be valued only through market returns because they sustain cultural understanding, scholarship, and mutual national interests.
- [Metafory intelektualniho vlastnictvi](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/metafory-intelektualniho-vlastnictvi/index.md): The piece argues that metaphors of ownership and theft distort debates about copying, creativity, and intellectual property.
- [Moc perspektivy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/moc-perspektivy/index.md): The review introduces Noam Chomsky's political and linguistic work and recommends Perspektivy moci despite its uneven selection and editorial shortcomings.
- [Morálky a doktríny](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/moralky-a-doktriny/index.md): The piece argues that the doctrine of preventive war and political pressure for conformity defeated moral and democratic objections to invading Iraq.
- [Morální politika: co vědí konservativci a liberálové ne](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/moralni-politika-co-vedi-konservativci-a-liberalove-ne/index.md): The review explains George Lakoff's account of American conservative and liberal morality as competing family models that structure political reasoning.
- [Musíme se srovnávat jen s těmi nejlepšími](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/musime-se-srovnavat-jen-s-temi-nejlepsimi/index.md): Zdeněk Starý discusses the Collegium Hieronymi Pragensis, comparative social-science teaching, and reforms needed to make Czech universities more flexible.
- [Mýtus o lásce k moudrosti](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/mytus-o-lasce-k-moudrosti/index.md): The review criticises Jaroslava Pešková's Role vědomí v dějinách for using opaque philosophical language in place of explanation and evidence.
- [Naše pravdy: Kognitivní vědy a kulturně-politické spory](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nase-pravdy-kognitivni-vedy-a-kulturne-politicke-spory/index.md): The piece uses cognitive science to explain why political disputes persist when groups organise facts through different conceptual frames.
- [Našinec, vašinec nebo jejichnec: Pohled ze za...](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nasinec-vasinec-nebo-jejichnec-pohled-ze-za/index.md): David Short discusses Czech language and culture, British perceptions of Czech society, national identity, and the challenges of translation.
- [Nejsme jako oni](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nejsme-jako-oni/index.md): The piece argues that opposing the death penalty protects society from institutionalised revenge, irreversible error, and ineffective prevention.
- [Nejsme jako oni, aneb jak neměřit člověka](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nejsme-jako-oni-aneb-jak-nemerit-cloveka/index.md): The piece reviews Psychologie Romů and criticises attempts to measure Roma people through racialised assumptions presented as social science.
- [Normální je nekouřit: Registrované partnerství, normálnost a pojmová integrace](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/normalni-je-nekourit-registrovane-partnerstvi-normalnost-a-pojmova-integrace/index.md): The piece analyses how appeals to normality structure arguments about registered partnerships and same-sex relationships.
- [Náboženství a demokracie](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nabozenstvi-a-demokracie/index.md): The piece argues that compatibility between religion and democracy depends on historically situated interpretations rather than on religious texts or Islam as a single essence.
- [Náš středověk](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/nas-stredovek/index.md): The essay argues that commercial medieval reenactment reveals modern identity-making more clearly than it recreates medieval life.
- [O nesnášenlivosti jako kulturní slepotě](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/o-nesnasenlivosti-jako-kulturni-slepote/index.md): The essay argues that intolerance arises from cultural blindness and from language that makes one worldview appear universally valid.
- [Paradoxy rozvoje](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/paradoxy-rozvoje/index.md): The essay argues that development programmes fail when they export Western institutions and technologies without understanding local social systems and contradictions.
- [Pohádky o spravedlnosti a občanská neposlušnost](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/pohadky-o-spravedlnosti-a-obcanska-neposlusnost/index.md): The piece argues that competing stories of justice shape whether civil disobedience appears principled or unlawful.
- [Pravdivé lži: Terminátor americké pravice o populaci a imigraci](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/pravdive-lzi-terminator-americke-pravice-o-populaci-a-imigraci/index.md): The review presents Pat Buchanan's book as a useful conservative manifesto whose demographic evidence is repeatedly used to support misleading cultural claims.
- [Prosím zrušte víceletá gymnázia](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/prosim-zruste-viceleta-gymnazia/index.md): The essay argues that selective multi-year grammar schools reproduce social advantage and should be replaced by equitable provision for able pupils in all schools.
- [Průměrností proti terorismu](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/prumernosti-proti-terorismu/index.md): The essay argues that terrorism remains rare because ordinary social and psychological constraints make organised violence difficult to execute.
- [Pynsent: Rozhovor pro LN](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/pynsent-rozhovor-pro-ln/index.md): In this interview Robert Pynsent challenges nationalist accounts of Czech literary history and assesses major Czech writers, democracy, and national identity.
- [Quick Notes on Measurement](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/quick-notes-on-measurement/index.md): The essay argues that measurement can reduce uncertainty without turning quantified models into the things they represent.
- [Remarkable Creatures: Epic Adventures in the Search for the Origins of Species](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/remarkable-creatures-epic-adventures-in-the-search-for-the-origins-of-species/index.md): The review examines several Darwin anniversary works and argues that their detailed scholarship can still reinforce a heroic mythology of scientific progress.
- [Romsky Brute](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/romsky-brute/index.md): The essay argues that Romani children's educational success requires bilingual schooling that values Romani language and identity rather than assimilation alone.
- [Sebevražda jako společensky prospěšný čin?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/sebevrazda-jako-spolecensky-prospesny-cin/index.md): The essay examines how cultures classify suicide as private tragedy, public sacrifice, or a challenge to their definition of life's value.
- [Spravedlnost nebo pomsta?](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/spravedlnost-nebo-pomsta/index.md): The essay argues that the United States should negotiate over the Taliban's offer to extradite Osama bin Laden instead of pursuing vengeance through bombing.
- [Stephen Colbert je Amerika](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/stephen-colbert-je-amerika/index.md): The review explains how Stephen Colbert's book uses an invented conservative persona to expose contradictions in American right-wing politics.
- [Střet fundamentalismů](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/stret-fundamentalismu/index.md): The review presents Tariq Ali's critique of both religious fundamentalism and Western economic imperialism while questioning his confidence in democratisation.
- [Ti, kteří přežili](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/ti-kteri-prezili/index.md): The review presents Jared Diamond's Collapse as an account of how environmental pressures interact with social decisions and cultural values.
- [To za Saddáma nebylo](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/to-za-saddama-nebylo/index.md): The essay argues that treating Saddam Hussein as a metonym for all Iraqi history prevents serious comparison between his regime and post-invasion Iraq.
- [Totalita v anarchii: aneb k čertu s mateřštinou](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/totalita-v-anarchii-aneb-k-certu-s-materstinou/index.md): The essay argues that standard Czech is a useful convention but becomes oppressive when linguistic conformity is equated with intelligence, morality, or social worth.
- [V každém z nás](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/v-kazdem-z-nas/index.md): The essay argues that understanding terrorists as ordinary human beings is necessary to resist revenge and preserve the rule of law after 11 September.
- [Válka proti liberalismu](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/valka-proti-liberalismu/index.md): The essay argues that the Taliban's rapid defeat does not invalidate liberal scrutiny of war, state power, and restrictions on civil liberties.
- [Války o pravopis: Česká pravopisná reforma z anglosaské perspektivy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/valky-o-pravopis-ceska-pravopisna-reforma-z-anglosaske-perspektivy/index.md): The review presents Neil Bermel's comparative study of Czech spelling disputes as an analysis of linguistic authority, national identity, and metaphors of language.
- [Výjimeční](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/vyjimecni/index.md): The review presents Malcolm Gladwell's argument that exceptional achievement depends on opportunity, accumulated practice, and social context as well as talent.
- [Věřme politikům](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/verme-politikum/index.md): The essay argues that political decisions are constrained by complex institutions and public expectations, so minor personal misconduct does not prove general political incompetence.
- [Za sekulární komunismus](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/za-sekularni-komunismus/index.md): The essay argues that communist commitments to equality and solidarity can function constructively when secularised, pluralised, and separated from state power.
- [Zamyšlení nad meditacemi o základech vědy](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/zamysleni-nad-meditacemi-o-zakladech-vedy/index.md): The review presents Petr Vopěnka's account of horizons and indeterminacy as a human-centred critique of science's claims to objective and complete knowledge.
- [Zamyšlení nad Multikulturní výchovou](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/zamysleni-nad-multikulturni-vychovou/index.md): The review commends Jan Průcha's critical survey of multicultural education while arguing that it underrepresents classroom practice, adult learning, and the interpretive limits of positivist research.
- [Úhly pohledu a střet civilizací](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/uhly-pohledu-a-stret-civilizaci/index.md): The essay argues that wartime conflicts presented as clashes of civilisation often arise from different cultural interpretations of shared values such as privacy, family, and dignity.
- [Černé dějiny](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/cerne-dejiny/index.md): The review argues that The Oxford Companion to Black British History restores minority actors to British history and offers a model for examining groups omitted from other national narratives.
- [Čistí a špinaví](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/cisti-a-spinavi/index.md): The piece shows how differences in praise, cleanliness, idioms, gestures, and refusal create consequential cross-cultural misunderstandings.
- [Řada nešťastných recenzí: Lemony Snicket, smrt rodičů a dětská literatura](https://dominiklukes.net/writing/rada-nestastnych-recenzi-lemony-snicket-smrt-rodicu-a-detska-literatura/index.md): The review recommends A Series of Unfortunate Events for its tragicomic style, educational humour, and treatment of death while examining the Czech translation's compromises.

- [Frames, schemas and cognition](https://dominiklukes.net/topics/frames-and-cognition/index.md): Cognitive linguistics: frames, image schemas, conceptual blending and folk theories as models of how meaning works.
- [Discourse analysis](https://dominiklukes.net/topics/discourse-analysis/index.md): How public, political and media debates are framed and negotiated, and methods for analysing them.

- [Guide to Deliberate Practice as a Universal Learning Method](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/deliberate-practice/index.md): An interactive guide to understanding and applying the principles of deliberate practice. Readers can adjust the display (dark mode, focus mode, reading ruler, text-to-speech, font, spacing and width), highlight text and add notes, ask an AI coach questions about the content, and track which sections they have read. The whole guide can be downloaded as an EPUB, and highlights can be exported as Markdown.
- [Increasing Reading Productivity](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/academic-reading/index.md): A book of ten sections built on the Academic Reading Framework, which treats academic reading as purposeful, strategic, non-linear, active, productive and interactive, and comparative and cumulative. Further sections cover the cognition of academic reading and narrative versus ruminative reading. Three interactive pieces are embedded in the text: a cognition explorer, a diagram of five levels of reading, and a simplified summary. The reader has a nested contents list, full-text search, highlights and notes, reading aids, browser read-aloud with text highlighting, and downloads as an EPUB and as plain text for AI agents. It is written by Dominik Lukeš.
- [Foundations of Readability](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/readability-foundations/index.md): A book of fourteen sections on making documents and presentations readable and accessible, drawing on cognitive load theory and reading strategy research. It sets out five principles (space, chunks, guides, information structure and simple language), ten tips each for documents and slides with visual examples, three steps to simple language, and sections on jargon and acronyms, accessibility and evidence. Embedded interactive pieces include a readability checker, a font size adjuster, a cramped-text reveal and slide examples. The reader has a nested contents list, full-text search, highlights and notes, reading aids, browser read-aloud with text highlighting, and downloads as an EPUB and as plain text for AI agents. It is written by Dominik Lukeš and released under CC BY.
- [Principles of Readability](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/readability-principles/index.md): A guide to clear-writing principles, with examples and checklists.
- [Building Your Language Muscle](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/language-muscle/index.md): An interactive companion to the guide Building Your Language Muscle, which applies deliberate practice to language learning. Readers can read the guide with progress tracking, highlight passages and export them as Markdown, and share quotes as images with QR codes. Three AI tools help with planning: a Resource Audit of the learning environment, a Sprint Builder that makes 6-week plans from a CEFR level and available time, and a Goal Tuner that maps vague goals to CEFR levels. An AI coach answers questions about the guide, and the full text can be downloaded as an EPUB.
- [Edutools: Explaining Concepts with Apps](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/edutools/index.md): A guide to vibecoding for educators, showing how to build apps that explain difficult concepts.
- [Skills Learning Companion](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/skills-companion/index.md): An interactive companion to the Schemas & Propositions post on LLM skills.
- [AI Trends & Frontier Capabilities](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/ai-trends/index.md): A living notebook recording the capabilities, tools and workflows of frontier AI models.
- [Academic Productivity](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/academic-productivity/index.md): An interactive resource that helps users understand what blocks their academic productivity, find strategies that reduce cognitive load, and choose assistive technologies, software tools and hardware. Sections cover strategies, blockers, assistive technology, a tools database and hardware. A tool card can fetch current information on pricing, reviews and updates through an AI-powered web search.
- [Course Design Frameworks](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/course-design-frameworks/index.md): An interactive toolkit for online course development that turns Dominik's course design frameworks into checklists, engagement matrices and activity planners. It is written for faculty and instructional designers who want to evaluate and improve online courses. Checklists keep track of progress in the browser, and planners can be edited in place to draft a plan.
- [Developing Competence](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/developing-competence/index.md): An interactive application based on the Developing Competence approach, which divides competence into conceptual (mental maps) and procedural (fluency) parts and describes progress from Novice through Apprentice and Practitioner to Expert. Users can read the theory, build a competency framework for any topic, assess themselves against it, see their coverage in radar and bar charts, and generate a development plan with goals, strategy and timeline. The framework builder, the assessment analysis and the plan use AI.
- [Dyslexia Guide](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/dyslexia-guide/index.md): A guide to dyslexia organised as lessons: why learn about dyslexia, what dyslexia is and its immediate impacts, structured and undistorted text, listening to text with text-to-speech tools, dictating instead of writing, and the visual aspects that make reading easier. The lessons are practical and give each topic what to know, what to read and what to do.
- [Instructional Videos Framework](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/instructional-videos-framework/index.md): An interactive guide to creating effective instructional videos in higher education, for educators. It turns Mayer's Principles of Multimedia Learning into tasks and advice, with each task linked to the principles behind it and to common questions. Readers can compare good and bad slides in interactive simulations, search across the guide, bookmark items, and download the guide as an EPUB.
- [Introduction to Key Issues in Language Through Stack Exchange Answers](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/key-issues-in-language/index.md): A book of all 253 answers Dominik wrote on Linguistics Stack Exchange between 2013 and 2016, on phonology, grammar, meaning, typology, sociolinguistics, language learning, linguistic theory, corpora and figurative language; 65 were accepted by the person who asked. The answers are grouped into nine sections, each as published, with links to the original question and answer.
- [LDD Navigator](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/ldd-navigator/index.md): A resource for professionals working with people who have learning difficulties and disabilities in the justice system. It helps identify behaviours that may indicate a learning difficulty, understand what might cause them and find practical strategies, with nine behaviours, four conditions (dyslexia, autism, ADHD and dyspraxia) and ten strategies. The original was developed in 2013 with Dyslexia Action and the National Autistic Society for prison staff. Dominik recreated the site in 2025 from the original design documents, and it is released under a CC BY licence. It has full-text search, font size controls and text-to-speech.
- [Online Reader Framework](https://dominiklukes.net/resources/online-reader/index.md): An open-source reader framework released under the MIT licence, based on Dominik’s readability and academic reading guides. Each book can have its own layout, nested contents and chapter outline. Readers can search the full text, highlight passages, add notes and track progress. Icon controls provide reading and formatting options, including anchored reading and a theme that follows the system setting. Browser read-aloud supports voice selection, skipping and text highlighting. Books can be downloaded as EPUBs in the browser, and their full text is available for AI agents.

Agentic AI systems are now capable and reliable in way that allows us to delegate meaningful work to them. In the second half of 2026 we now have access to AI agents that can not just reliably work with files on computers but also use existing tools across a data processing workflow that have only been available to very few. This creates new opportunities for working with large amounts of data, from organising and maintaining collections to carrying out analysis. It also makes best reproducibility practices much more within reach for busy researchers. - [Vibecoding as pedagogy: Transforming learning and teaching through making tools](https://dominiklukes.net/speaking/vibecoding-as-pedagogy/index.md): The question of AI in education is often reduced to debating about the impact of ChatGPT on the integrity of assessment. But AI in 2026 is not just ChatGPT and not just about what answers can be produced by a Large Language Model. One of the leading trends is the rise of agentic AI systems that can not only write snippets of code but build entire software systems or websites. This new approach to AI-assisted software development is often referred to as 'vibecoding' and it is this style of coding that is the focus of this talk. The webinar will outline the state of the art and its implications, looking at the key tools and the best ways for educators to approach getting to know them in order to integrate them into their work.
- [Teaching during the Cognitive Revolution: What will learning and teaching look like in the age of AI?](https://dominiklukes.net/speaking/teaching-cognitive-revolution/index.md): The emergence of Large Language Models has disrupted expectations of computing and technology's role in learning. This session explores how AI can support learners and educators at every stage, from managing cognitive load to serving as productivity assistants, peer reviewers, tutors, and toolmakers.
- [Vibecoding for Language Teachers: Making apps for language learning with AI](https://dominiklukes.net/speaking/vibecoding-language-teachers/index.md): This hands-on workshop introduces language teachers to AI-assisted coding ('vibecoding') as a powerful new avenue for creating language learning applications. Using Gemini and Google AI Studio, the session demonstrates how educators can design, prototype, and deploy simple apps without prior programming expertise. Beyond technical skills, the workshop invites critical reflection on the pedagogical possibilities enabled by AI-assisted app creation.
- [Three Years After ChatGPT: From chatbots to agents and other trends on the frontier of generative AI](https://dominiklukes.net/speaking/three-years-after-chatgpt/index.md): Three years after the public launch of ChatGPT, the chatbot paradigm has undergone a transformation. The main mode of interacting with Large Language Models is no longer just a chat. This session steps back from day-to-day trends to look at how the landscape has shifted since 2022 and what the current frontier in what 'AI can do' and what 'we can do with AI' looks like.
- [How LLMs Understand Text: Context and Meaning in the AI Age](https://dominiklukes.net/speaking/llms-understand-text/index.md): Large Language Models represent an entirely new paradigm of semantic information processing. They are the first time a computer can process the meaning of text without mark-up. Their ability to 'understand' text is at the same time familiarly human and completely alien. This talk outlines how Large Language Models 'read' and 'understand' text, and how they generate their response, contrasting with how humans perform the same tasks.
